BiblicalUsage: Gidom is a place in Palestine, named once in Scripture, in Judges. The full story of the place lives in the Bible itself, and this study covers only the name’s use.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Gidom matters because God met His people in real places, not in abstractions. I hold that Gidom is worth knowing by name, even when the Bible says little about it.
